title: extUnit zero
statement: For exact additive U and η:F→UH with DerivedUnit [def-sp-exact-functor-derived-unit], the degree-zero class mk0(η) has DerivedExtUnit [def-sp-derived-scalar-ext-unit].

proof.text: The zero-shift functor is canonically isomorphic to the identity. Transfer the domain Hom set through that isomorphism and use the given unit bijection. The zero-shift coherence for exact derived functors and the formula for mk0 identify the transferred function with the displayed degree-zero Ext unit.
